ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use
District symbols as shown on Map No. 7-3

in the area bounded by:

The public alley next northeast of and parallel to Milwaukee Avenue; A line 49.65 feet

southeasterly of and parallel to North Dawson Avenue; North Milwaukee Avenue; and

North Dawson Avenue;

To those of a C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 2839 N. Milwaukee Avenue
